gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like neon tubing, one steady line you could trace with a finger. Under Snowburst One's stencil-cut display lettering, a longer passage would read smoothly, with open terminals keeping each line light.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-golos-text: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges breaking up each shape. Golos Text sits below with a big x-height and vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight, so keep it modest in size.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-heebo: Snowburst One is a stencil-cut display face, bold and expressive, with bridges running between its letters. Heebo's strongest quality is its tall central band of text, with curves that stop short instead of closing in.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads like bent dowels, its s curves opening wide at both ends. And if Snowburst One were made small, its stencil bridges would crowd, so give the plain sans room to carry the text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hind-vadodara: Sharp stencil cuts, loud and expressive, then a rope-like body of Hind Vadodara with spacious gaps in every rounded glyph. Snowburst One shouts the opening; the plain sans follows quietly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-huninn: Huninn reads like a plotter pen at work, its lowercase rising close to cap height with s terminals held clear of the body. Snowburst One's stencil bridges make the heading loud, so a long page of this sans-serif feels steady.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-inter-tight: Expressive is the mood up top, where Snowburst One cuts stencil bridges between its letters, while Inter Tight below bends like tubing with almost no stroke contrast. One shouts, the other hums.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-karla: Bold stencil bridges mark Snowburst One, while Karla below has a gaping c opening and a stocky middle band. And a slightly larger size lets that sans-serif body hold its own.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-kedebideri: Snowburst One brings expressive stencil lettering with wide bridges between its letters, over a sans-serif body with a skyward x-height. Its strongest quality is the rounded, inviting Kedebideri.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-khula: Wide bridges slice through Snowburst One's stencil letters, giving the heading a bold, expressive look. And Khula follows with a deep midsection and curves that keep their mouths open, so long paragraphs stay easy going.
